assignments.name: Mitosis Analysis
assignments.description: Analyze the stages of mitosis using the provided microscope slides. Identify and document each phase: prophase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase.
assignments.instructions:
1. Observe the onion root tip slides under the microscope
2. Capture images of cells in each mitosis phase
3. Label the structures visible in each phase
4. Write a brief description of what occurs during each phase
5. Submit your analysis document and captured images

assignments.name: Neural Network Lab
assignments.description: Build a simple neural network to classify handwritten digits using the MNIST dataset.
assignments.instructions:
1. Load and preprocess the MNIST dataset
2. Design a neural network architecture with at least 2 hidden layers
3. Train the model and evaluate its accuracy
4. Document your architecture choices and results
5. Submit your code and a brief report

assignments.name: Microscopy Basics Quiz
assignments.description: Complete the quiz on microscopy fundamentals covering types of microscopes, magnification, and proper usage.
assignments.instructions:
1. Review the microscopy chapter in your textbook
2. Complete all 25 multiple-choice questions
3. You have 45 minutes to complete the quiz
4. Each question is worth 4 points
